assertions.description: Output lists specific files found in the docs/ directory of the project
assertions.evidence: Phase 1 (Discovery) contains a full table listing 32+ specific MD files found in docs/ with names, line counts, token estimates, and git dates. Examples: IDEAL_MASTER_PLAN.md (2559 lines, ~10236 tokens), UX_DESIGN_v1.md (1103 lines), DEPLOY_GCP.md (1062 lines), etc.

assertions.description: Output cross-checks which docs/ files are referenced from CLAUDE.md or other navigation documents and flags unreferenced ones
assertions.evidence: Phase 2 explicitly cross-checks CLAUDE.md references, listing explicit nav links, tree mentions, and group references. Phase 3 tier-table categorizes all files — 22 flagged as orphans with note 'Orphan: нет ссылок'. Statistics: 16 full orphans + 6 changelog-only mentions flagged.

assertions.description: Output classifies orphan docs into Archive tier using the specific tier name 'Archive'
assertions.evidence: Tier-table in Phase 3 (Synthesis) uses column 'Tier' with value 'Archive' for all 22 orphan files. Example rows: '| Archive | docs/IDEAL_MASTER_PLAN.md | Orphan: нет ссылок; untracked в git...' and '| Archive | docs/UX_DESIGN_v1.md | Orphan: нет ссылок...'

assertions.description: Output assigns AP-XX codes to orphan documentation antipatterns
assertions.evidence: Anti-patterns section explicitly uses: 'AP-03 | docs/ directory | 22 файла из 32 не имеют навигационных ссылок из CLAUDE.md — полные orphan docs | Severity: HIGH'
